CFML Language Reference: Functions

ASin

Returns the angle, in radians, whose sine is the given number. The result lies between -pi/2 and pi/2.

Category

Mathematical functions

Syntax

ASin(number)

Parameters

number
The sine of the angle: a number between -1 and 1 inclusive.

Returns

The angle in radians, from -Pi()/2 to Pi()/2.

Usage

A value outside the range -1 to 1 raises an Expression error. Multiply the result by 180 / Pi() to get degrees.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>number</TH><TH>ASin (radians)</TH><TH>degrees</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="n" LIST="-1,-0.5,0,0.5,1">
<CFSET r = ASin(n)>
<CFOUTPUT><TR><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#n#</TD><TD>#NumberFormat(r, "9.9999")#</TD>
<TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#Round(r * 180 / Pi())#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
